## Bad event

At an apply, the resulting live permissions exceed the policy ceiling or differ from the approved desired state, or a diff is applied that an independent reviewer did not approve exactly. Out-of-band changes BETWEEN applies are reverted at the next reconcile, not prevented: with reconcile at least every W ticks and ≤ d mutations per tick, drift ≤ d·W grants and each lives < W ticks (SC17Drift.drift_bounded/drift_lifetime; REVIEW-PACKET finding 2). Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem).
